source = '''from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from math import gcd

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                pts[grid[r][c]].append((r, c))
    singleton = [p[0] for p in pts.values() if len(p) == 1]
    hub = singleton[0] if len(singleton) == 1 else None
    allpts = [p for ps in pts.values() for p in ps]
    center = (sum(r for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts), sum(c for r, c in allpts) / len(allpts))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color, cells in pts.items():
        if len(cells) < 2:
            continue
        cr, cc = hub if hub is not None else center
        outer = max(cells, key=lambda p: (p[0] - cr) ** 2 + (p[1] - cc) ** 2)
        inner = min((p for p in cells if p != outer), key=lambda p: (p[0] - outer[0]) ** 2 + (p[1] - outer[1]) ** 2)
        dr, dc = outer[0] - inner[0], outer[1] - inner[1]
        g = gcd(abs(dr), abs(dc))
        dr, dc = dr // g, dc // g
        r, c = outer[0] + dr, outer[1] + dc
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:
            if out[r][c] != bg:
                break
            out[r][c] = color
            r, c = r + dr, c + dc
    return out
'''
